pack.name: Street Editorial
pack.description: High-fashion studio editorial meets raw street art. This pack features stunning Black models layered with oversized, chaotic graffiti and bold brush-stroke typography for a gritty, professional aesthetic.

templates.title: Street Editorial - Silver Puffer
templates.prompt_text: A photorealistic high-fashion studio editorial photo of a stunning Black woman with a confident pose, wearing a chrome-silver puffer jacket. The background is a neutral grey studio wall covered in oversized, messy hand-drawn graffiti text in electric yellow and black. Layered over the image is bold, aggressive brush-stroke typography and scribbles in white. The lighting is sharp and professional. The overall aesthetic is edgy and futuristic street-style. --ar 4:5
